posts.preview: Phase 2 of the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Poverty Eradication, Labour and Industrial Relations’ assessment of compliance with labour standards, as administered by the Ministry of Justice, Labour and Industrial Relations in the retail and wholesale sector, will commence soon
Committee Mandate (Summarised for Labour Law Compliance Assessment in the Retail and Wholesale Sector)

The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Poverty Eradication, Labour and Industrial Relations, established under Article 63(2)(f) of the Constitution of the Republic of Namibia, exercises parliamentary oversight over the Ministry of Justice, Labour and Industrial Relations. In undertaking its assessment of compliance...
Monitor and enquire into matters relating to industrial relations, employment creation and human resource development.
